name: JONES — scale-free semi-endogenous intensity economy (FD-3D flagship)
summary: Process: the production model with EXACTLY TWO surgical scale-effect removals, everything else identical (perfect-substitutes AK, log utility, phi_j, production R&D technology, full nonlinear logN(Y; lambda3) with the damage jump J_n(Y), full robustness xi including h_y and jump distortions): (1) tech-jump hazard = (K0/varrho) e^{s}, s = logR - logK — knowledge INTENSITY, the Jones semi-endogenous critique (rho_s = varrho/K0 = 0.8485; equals production's 0.0150/yr at t=0 exactly); (2) intensity emissions E(Z) = eta A_d(1-Z) K0 = 10.01 at t=0 — Kaya-composition climate (growth is emissions-neutral, only the dirty mix warms). Merged member: the homogeneity-lens INTENSITY and innovation-lens JONES designs are the same economy (identical calibration and reduction) — one build, taking each critique's fixes. Exact reduction V = logK + W(Z, Y, s), sympy-verified independently by both design teams (logK coefficient delta(1-A) forces A = 1, zero residual logK terms; jump gaps logK-free). Corrections applied: s-grid EXTENDED to [-6, +2] = the full production box image (the old s_max = -1 'imminent jump' boundary rationale is numerically false — hazard 0.43/yr there; at s = +2 hazard 8.7/yr makes W ~ W_postTech a defensible far-field anchor at the TRUE edge); jump sources treated SEMI-IMPLICITLY (implicit -J W diagonal sink, explicit downstream gain J W^post) because J dt >> 1 near the top edge; the O(sigma^2) = 1e-4 W_sZ cross term discretized by a monotone diagonal-dominant splitting with Richardson evidence, replacing the bare Barles–Souganidis claim.
solution_formulas: Reduced 3-D HJB (pre-damage pre-tech; sigma^2(Z) = sigma_d^2(1-Z)^2 + sigma_g^2 Z^2): 0 = max_{i_d,i_g,i_r}{ delta log c - delta logN_pre(Y) - delta W + [(1-Z)phi_d + Z phi_g - sigma^2(Z)/2](1 - W_s) + (sigma^2(Z)/2 + sigma_r^2/2) W_ss + Z(1-Z)[phi_g - phi_d + (1-Z)sigma_d^2 - Z sigma_g^2] W_Z + Z^2(1-Z)^2(sigma_d^2 + sigma_g^2)/2 W_ZZ + [Z(1-Z)^2 sigma_d^2 - Z^2(1-Z) sigma_g^2] W_sZ + thetabar E(Z) W_Y + varsigma^2 E(Z)^2/2 W_YY + [psi0 i_r^{1/2} e^{-s/2} - sigma_r^2/2] W_s - (1/2xi)(L_d^2 + L_g^2 + L_r^2 + L_y^2) } + xi(e^{s}/rho_s)[1 - e^{-(W^{postT} - W)/xi}] + xi Sum_l (1/5) J_n(Y)[1 - e^{-(W^l - W)/xi}], with loadings L_d = (1 - W_s - Z W_Z)(1-Z)sigma_d, L_g = (1 - W_s + (1-Z)W_Z) Z sigma_g, L_r = W_s sigma_r, L_y = W_Y E(Z) varsigma. FOCs: delta/c = phi_d'(i_d)[1 - W_s - Z W_Z] = phi_g'(i_g)[1 - W_s + (1-Z)W_Z] = (psi0/2) i_r^{-1/2} e^{-s/2} W_s, i.e. production's i_r FOC with V_logR -> W_s; i_r = [psi0 e^{-s/2} W_s c/(2 delta)]^2; Newton on 3 FOCs + budget (models_v3 pattern). Regime ladder: 5x 2-D PostD-PostT W^l(Z,Y) -> 2-D PreD-PostT (damage jump) -> 5x 3-D PostD-PreT (tech jump) -> 3-D PreD-PreT (both jumps); xi in {0.05, 0.1, 148.4}. Grids: Z 61 on [0.01, 0.99], Y 41 on [0, 4] (post-damage solved on full [0,4] for lift coverage; economically visited Y >= 2.5), s 61 on [-6, 2]. Damage coefficients IMPORTED from the repo implementation (value+slope-continuous), not re-derived. Scheme: fd_pdpt_v5_stable PIBYS pattern — false-transient + Howard, upwind first-order, semi-implicit jump sinks, monotone cross-term splitting, relax 0.3, tail-averaging, mutual-consistency gate.
lift_map: Shares ALL FOUR production states — nothing collapsed; the economy differs by equations, not state deletion. At any input: s = logR - logK (no clip needed; grid covers the box image [-6, 2]). v(x) = logK + W_reg(Z, Y, s; lambda3, xi): trilinear in (Z, Y, s), linear across the 5 lambda3 slices (post-damage nets), linear in logxi across the 3 xi solves; repo per-regime +/-logN value transform applied exactly as make_map_anchor.py consumes it. Policies: i_d, i_g, i_r = the FD fields with the same interpolation; i_r nontrivial in logR, logK, Z, AND Y (production's exact FOC functional form, so magnitudes land at production scale at s0 = -4.364). Post-tech regimes: v = logK + W(Z, Y; lambda3, xi), policies (Z, Y) only, no i_r net — matches the production layout. The lift asserts V_logK = 1 - W_s ~ 0.95-1 at every point: the unit-slope member of the verified FD solution family, maximally far from the 0.37 attractor.
plots: (1) Policy triptych: i_d, i_g, i_r heatmaps over (Z, s) at Y = 1.1 with (Z0, s0) = (0.7, -4.364) marked. (2) Value structure: W(Z, Y) at s0 and the marginal value v_logK = 1 - W_s over (Z, s) — the unit-homogeneity signature against the trained attractor's 0.37. (3) Simulated reduced-state paths (Z_t, Y_t, s_t) from the initial point under FD policies for xi in {148.4, 0.1, 0.05}: i_d, i_g, i_r, Z, hazard e^{s}/rho_s, pre/post branches overlaid.
